# FraudLabs Pro

FraudLabs Pro is an online payment fraud detection service that helps merchants minimize chargebacks and maximize revenue by detecting fraud across various payment methods.

Category: Security & Ops. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/fraudlabs-pro/.

## Actions

- **Create FraudLabs Pro Account**: Create a new user account under a reseller.
- **FLP Feedback Order**: Submit feedback on a screened order.
- **FraudLabs Pro Screen Order** (read-only): Screen orders for fraud.
- **Get FraudLabs Pro Order Result** (read-only): Retrieve the fraud analysis result of a previously screened order.
- **Get SMS Verification Result** (read-only): Retrieve SMS verification result.
- **Send SMS OTP Verification**: Send SMS OTP for phone verification.
- **Subscribe Reseller Plan**: Subscribe a reseller account to a specific plan.
- **Test Order Status Changed Webhook Delivery** (read-only): Send a test webhook payload to the provided callback URL for FraudLabs Pro order status change notifications.
